proposals.evidence: Turner vahya gives Prakrit vojjha burden and Oriya bojha, Bengali bojhā and Hindi bojh load, with crossing from voḍhum. The survey uses this burden/weight word adjectivally for heavy. These are qualified regional family comparisons; Turner explicitly identifies Hindi diffusion of the noun into several western languages, so uninterrupted local inheritance is not asserted.
